title: PIB Fact Check: Viral Messages Claiming Free Laptop Distribution Under Government Scheme Are Fake
content: A message is circulating on social media claiming that the Government of India is providing free laptops to all students. This claim is FAKE. No such scheme is being operated by the central government. Fraudulent messages frequently share deceptive web addresses claiming that students who passed 10th or 12th standards can register for free laptops by submitting Aadhaar numbers and personal contact information. The Press Information Bureau cautions citizens that the Central Government runs no scheme titled PM Free Laptop Distribution Scheme. Official academic support and scholarship programs are managed strictly through verified domains such as scholarships.gov.in. Citizens are advised not to share personal credentials or register on unverified third-party websites claiming to distribute free electronic devices.
